title: Formal Calculation of Binomial Coefficients
content: Formal Calculation provides formulas for computing nested sums, offers results for all three forms, and explores the connections between them. It is a powerful tool for studying various numbers in a unified manner, making special numbers of many kinds appear ordinary. Additionally, this paper generalizes Wilson's theorem, Wolstenholme's theorem, and the Eulerian polynomial, demonstrating that they are merely special cases.
